segments.text: Would you support a nationwide mandate of the COVID vaccine once it comes out?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: You don't want to mandate and try and force anyone to take a vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Starting tomorrow in the district, you'll have to show proof of vaccination to dine out, go to the gym, see a concert, or catch a sports game.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: Masks, vaccines, no food, can't go to certain places without a mask on or if you don't have a vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Doctors turning down patients because they aren't vaccinated, determining who will live and who will die.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: This is absurd, but it was coming.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And compliance is the driving force.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It's an attempt to turn the mandates into laws, because mandates are not laws.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So that now, if we don't obey the laws, which were once illegal mandates, now we're subject to the criminal justice system.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And within that system, now we become involuntary servants.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And so the 13th Amendment no longer applies to us.
